stories.title: MPs to question North Wales Police Commissioner over UK Government’s policing shake-up
stories.summary: North Wales Police and Crime Commissioner Andy Dunbobbin is among four Welsh PCCs to be questioned by MPs next month over government plans to abolish elected police commissioners by May 2028. The Welsh Affairs Committee has announced a session on 8 July at which all four of Wales’ Police and Crime Commissioners will give evidence
